 Follow Us On: News Trending News Madhya Pradesh boy, 6, wins car worth Rs 50 lakh a year after family bought coupon Madhya Pradesh boy, 6, wins car worth Rs 50 lakh a year after family bought coupon
 A 6-year-old boy from Madhya Pradesh won a Toyota Fortuner after his grandmother bought a Rs 200 Garba coupon. The surprise result fulfilled the Burhanpur family's two-year hope of owning a car.
 Advertisement Madhya Pradesh boy, 6, wins car worth Rs 50 lakh, a year after family bought coupon By: India Today Trending Desk Burhanpur , Oct 28, 2026 19:53 IST Last Updated Oct 28, 2026 19:53 IST Published by Yashna Talwar Oct 28, 2026 13:19 IST A 6-year-old boy from Madhya Pradesh’s Burhanpur won a Toyota Fortuner worth around Rs 50 lakh in a lucky draw after his grandmother purchased a coupon for just Rs 200 at a Garba event.
 Medansh Raikwar, a resident of Seelampura, won the first prize in a lucky draw organised at Shri Sarkar Dham in Abhapuri. His win came as a surprise to the family, who had bought the coupon nearly a year earlier.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Medansh’s grandmother, Kiran Raikwar, had attended a Garba event at Abhapuri Dham a year ago, where she purchased a lucky draw coupon and entered her grandson’s name.
 The family had been hoping to own a car for the past two years, but little did they know that the coupon would eventually bring them a Fortuner.
 Watch the video here: 
 When Medansh’s name was announced as the winner in 2026, the family was overjoyed. The young boy received a grand welcome, with drums beating and celebrations taking place as he arrived to claim the prize.
 The new car was also taken through a traditional puja to seek blessings, while relatives and local residents joined the family in congratulating Medansh on his unexpected win. - Ends
